Anya: Quick async check on quarterly milestones — keeping this short. What shipped, what slipped, and owners for final handoffs.
Anya: Shipped: autoscale-v2 beta (limited traffic), canary routing for hosted API.
Anya: Slipped: embeddings cache rollout (DB migration risk), model-routing policy UI, and one infra perf regression on 40k token seqs.
Anya: Asking owners: who will own final rollout for embeddings cache and the perf fix? Also need CRs merged for autoscale followups.
Sam: I can own embeddings cache rollout coordination with infra. ETA to finish migration plan: EOD Tue.
Sam: Question — do we have a rollback plan if the migration causes latency spikes?
Mike: @Sam yes — incremental migration with metrics gate. I put the gate in the migration doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/migrations/embeddings-cache
Mike: Also pinging infra for perf regression: PR 3421 (investigate TTFB on long sequences).
Leo: From product side, model-routing UI slip blocks a few Dedicated customers. Can we prioritize a minimal UX patch to expose the policy toggle? Owner?
Priya: I'm available to help validate performance after migration and run the canary. Suggest adding a smoke test in deploy pipeline:
Priya: ```
- run: smoke/model-embeddings-check
- success: 95th latency < 120ms
```
Mike: PRs needing CR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3421 (perf), https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3389 (autoscale followups). Please drop quick reviews.
Anya: Owners summary: Sam = embeddings rollout lead, Mike = perf fix lead, Leo = small-product-UX for policy toggle (help from Sam), Priya = canary/validation.
Anya: Next steps: owners comment with 1-line ETA by EOD today. If slipped beyond next week, we add to next sprint.
Sam: ETA for migration plan doc + risk checklist = 2025-06-18 (EOD).
Mike: Perf PR will need 2 reviews, I expect to finish analysis by 2025-06-19.
Leo: Will prototype minimal toggle by 2025-06-20, then hand to Sam for integration.
Priya: I'll add the smoke test to the canary pipeline today.
Mike: small note — tagging @deploy-bot to run a dry canary after PR merges.
deploy-bot: Scheduled dry canary for channel=product on 2025-06-20 18:00 UTC (dry-run). (reacted with :white_check_mark:)
Anya: Thanks — if owners can drop the short ETAs as above, I’ll convert into the milestone tracker and send for cross-org visibility.
Sam: 👍 will post status update in milestone tracker when plan is ready.
Mike: 👍 2CRs requested — will nudge reviewers.
Leo: :shipit: will coordinate with customer success for heads-up emails once toggle is ready.
Anya: Closing — small followups only, flag anything blocking. Thanks all.
